# tenure intention

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](gmeow-tenureIntention.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureIntention>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)

The desire or intention the tenure records the agent as holding over its interval. Functional: one tenure, one mode. [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) tenure is carried by the [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) relator's own temporal scope (relators are time-indexed by construction); the tenure class exists for the intrinsic modes, whose adoption and abandonment would otherwise be invisible.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](gmeow-tenureIntention.md) from [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) to [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
